brief.headline: Record missile barrage on Kyiv; escalation campaign targets ports
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels overwhelmingly celebrated an intensified deep-strike campaign on Ukrainian cities, ports and logistics — led by claims of a record 40 ballistic missiles fired at Kyiv in under an hour — while grudgingly acknowledging Ukrainian drone damage to Wildberries warehouses and Belgorod-area civilian casualties.

developments.title: Channels claim record ballistic barrage on Kyiv
developments.body: Two Majors and WarGonzo claimed Russia fired its largest single-night ballistic salvo at Kyiv — 40 missiles in 53 minutes (WarGonzo cites 31–40+ Iskanders and Zircons plus drones). Channels claim hits on the Radioniks and Artem plants producing missile control systems (including for the Flamingo). All figures are channel-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Coordinated 'escalation campaign' framing targets ports and logistics
developments.body: Multiple channels described a politically authorized escalation targeting Ukrainian ports, energy and maritime infrastructure, citing strikes on Odesa port, Pivdenny, and logistics hubs including AMTEL (claimed 100,000 sqm), Nova Poshta and DB Schenker sites. Damage claims are unverified and framed as revenge for Ukrainian strikes on Wildberries.

developments.title: Rybar tallies week of railway and fuel-infrastructure strikes
developments.body: Rybar reported an escalating campaign against rolling stock and railways (mainly Geran drones) and claimed 51 Ukrainian gas stations destroyed July 10–18, concentrated in Sumy and Kharkiv. Poddubny echoed railway/substation strikes in Zaporizhzhia and Chernihiv. All figures are channel-sourced.

developments.title: Claimed advances at Pokrovsk, Kupyansk and Hulyaipole
developments.body: Kotsnews and Poddubny claimed capture of Volnoe in Dnipropetrovsk region with a destroyed enemy platoon; Sladkov claimed control of Oskol crossings near Kupyansk; Kotsnews claimed a penetration west of Novoseliovka with 20+ Ukrainian surrenders. All battlefield claims unconfirmed.

developments.title: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Wildberries, injure civilians
developments.body: Channels reported Ukrainian drones disabled 7% of Wildberries capacity (restoration cost cited at 20–35.8bn rubles) and struck civilian areas — three children and two women injured in Razumnoye, a woman killed in LNR's Kreminna. This drove the day's only significant negative sentiment.

developments.title: Rybar breaks ranks on stalled Russian nuclear diplomacy in Africa
developments.body: In a rare self-critical post (its most-viewed, 159k), Rybar said Russia's atomic diplomacy in Africa has stalled — nuclear projects promised but unbuilt — causing ongoing reputational damage. Notable as internal criticism amid an otherwise triumphalist day.

narrative_watch.title: Strikes framed as 'rational' economic warfare and revenge
narrative_watch.body: Channels increasingly justify strikes on civilian-adjacent logistics (supermarkets, Nova Poshta, Wildberries retaliation) as legitimate economic targeting, with Starshe Eddy explicitly urging hits on Kyiv supermarkets.

narrative_watch.title: Soros/Western-ownership tagging of struck targets
narrative_watch.body: Poddubny highlighted an AMTEL logistics center as 'Soros-linked,' a recurring device framing economic targets as Western proxies to legitimize strikes.

narrative_watch.title: Iran-US clash amplified as Western vulnerability
narrative_watch.body: Rybar's high-view post on Iran striking a US base in Jordan signals interest in framing widening Middle East conflict as evidence of overextended American power.

mood_lines.text: Euphoric: 30 posts, uniformly positive, celebrating record Kyiv barrage and sustained port/logistics campaign as decisive economic damage.
Confident: claimed advances at Pokrovsk, Kupyansk and Hulyaipole, with surrender and capture footage emphasized.
Negative but improving (net -43, up 25): grievance over Wildberries damage and civilian casualties, partly offset by counter-battery claims.
Sourer (net -40, move -54): focus on Armenian election Western influence and Kyiv protests over Fedorov dismissal.
Mostly upbeat on drone units and border defenses, but dented by Rybar's rare criticism of stalled African nuclear diplomacy.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine strikes on Russia sentiment shifts +25 to net -43
flag_texts.body: Still negative, driven by Wildberries warehouse damage claims and civilian casualties in Belgorod and LNR, but partly softened by posts touting Russian counter-drone kills near Dobropillia.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO sentiment drops 54 points to net -40
flag_texts.body: Coverage soured on Western influence narratives — Rybar on Starlink and Western ventures shaping Armenian elections, and Two Majors on Kyiv protests over ex-minister Fedorov framed as infighting among Western sponsors.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist topics silent: mobilisation and Putin criticism
flag_texts.body: No posts touched mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin, consistent with the day's triumphalist strike-focused messaging and near-total (80%) positive sentiment.
